usage: analyze_best_last.py [-h] --sources SOURCES --out OUT

Reaggregate existing per-image CSVs; no images, models, inference or training.
Python >=3.10; standard library only. Computes original and postprocessed
stages separately. G4's tail requirement is GLOBAL, not a new leave-one tail
criterion. Original-stage applications of G4 are explicitly diagnostic, not
historical gates. Never selects a checkpoint using final evaluation results.
Refuses output overwrite.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --sources SOURCES
  --out OUT

usage: analyze_timing.py [-h] --run-dir RUN_DIR --out OUT

Optional replay of existing timing records; no new measurement or inference.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --run-dir RUN_DIR
  --out OUT

usage: verify_release.py [-h] [--root ROOT]

Read-only package integrity and record-shape checks; no scientific reanalysis.
No images, model weights, training, inference, pixel scoring, or bootstrap are
run. Python >=3.10; standard library only.

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT

limitations: This is a local package integrity and public-scope preparation check, not a new scientific experiment or universal privacy/licensing certificate.
